quote: Our second contribution develops SummHay's evaluation protocol, centering on evaluating system outputs on their Coverage of reference insights, and the quality of their Citation.
We evaluate system outputs using Coverage scores, Citation scores (F1 of precision and recall), and a Joint score that combines both.
The final coverage score of a summary is the average coverage on all the insights of the subtopic, such that it ranges from 0 to 100.
